scenes.voice: A cache makes reads fast. It also gives you a new problem: stale data.
Cache data that's read often and changes rarely. A product catalog is a good example.
Don't cache anything that must be exact right now, like an account balance.
When the data changes, remove the cached copy. Or set a time to live, so it expires on its own.
Knowing when to invalidate is the hard part. Save this for the next time you add a cache.
If this helped, follow, like, share, and subscribe.
